I'm looking for any technical role in software engineering. I'm ready to learn, adapt and take on whatever the team needs.

projects.title: Web CRM – Lead Tracker and Team Output Manager
projects.summary: An internal CRM I built with Emergent AI so the Creators Impex team can manage leads, clients, payments and work in one place.
projects.problem: At Creators Impex, a 5-member team tracked its work by hand and made the first round of calls to cold leads manually. The team needed one place to manage leads, client details and payments, with each person seeing only what their role needed.
projects.approach:
I gathered requirements from the team, then built the CRM with Emergent AI, an AI app builder. I wrote the prompts and tested each feature with the people who would use it.

The CRM has role-based access for Admin, Sales and Ops. Each client has a card with departure and arrival cities, travel times and passport number. A payment overview shows each client's total and pending amount, and guests are allocated rooms automatically by gender and companionship. Alongside it, I set up an AI caller with Kraya for the first round of calls to cold leads.
projects.challenges: The hardest part was connecting the CRM to WhatsApp so the team could update a lead's status from chat. It needed Meta's approval for the WhatsApp Business API and for the business display name, and sending messages in bulk got the company's number blocked along the way. The integration now works, and the team updates lead status directly from WhatsApp.
projects.outcome:
The team now manages its people, leads and lead status in one system instead of by hand. The payment overview shows at a glance how much is paid and how much is pending, client cards keep travel and passport details together, and the first round of calls to cold leads runs through the AI caller instead of a person.

This is an internal company tool, so there is no public demo or source code.
projects.next_steps: Improve the payment details and connect the CRM to the company website, so new enquiries reach it automatically.

projects.title: Developer portfolio
projects.summary: This site: a fast, static React portfolio where all content lives in one JSON file.
projects.problem: I wanted a portfolio that recruiters can read in under a minute, that loads instantly on any connection, and that I can update without fighting a CMS or paying for a server.
projects.approach: It is a single-page React app built with Vite, styled with Tailwind CSS and routed with React Router, so each project gets its own case-study page at /projects/<slug>. Every piece of content (profile, journey, experience, projects, skills, certifications) lives in one file, src/data/content.json, which the components read through a React context. The contact form posts directly to Formspree, so there is no server to host or maintain. The site deploys to Vercel as static files.
projects.challenges: Keeping content separate from layout: I defined one JSON structure that every section reads from, so adding a project or a certificate means editing data, not JSX. The contact form needed spam protection without a CAPTCHA, so it uses a hidden honeypot field that Formspree discards automatically, plus input checks in the browser before anything is sent. I also made the form disappear cleanly when no Formspree ID is configured, so the site never shows a form that cannot send.
projects.outcome: Updating the site is now: edit content.json, commit, push, and Vercel redeploys automatically.
projects.next_steps: Add a short blog section written in Markdown and an automated Lighthouse check on every push.
